title: EffectReceipt
description: EIP-712 typed receipt emitted by the tool adapter after the compensable action runs. Realizes the observable evidence object o = effect evidence in the settleability model (main.tex:127).

schemaVersion.description: Must equal the registered κ schemaVersion or the ClaimRegistry rejects the commit.

contractId.description: Identifier of the κ this action was admitted under.

jobId.description: Adapter-issued job identifier; one EffectReceipt per jobId.

intentHash.description: Hash of the agent's intent (natural-language or structured) at decision time. Binding evidence that the dispatched action matches what the agent meant.

paramsHash.description: Hash of the canonical, sorted parameter blob dispatched to the adapter.

resourceId.description: Hash of the (scope-conforming) resource identifier touched by this action.

preStateDigest.description: Adapter-computed digest of state before execution. For Postgres: hash of (table_oid, snapshot_lsn, predicate_count). For Git: hash of (oid_before, branch_tip_oid). For Cloud: hash of canonical-JSON of the pre-state config.

postStateDigest.description: Adapter-computed digest of state after execution. Same shape as preStateDigest per workload.

providerReceiptHash.description: Optional. Hash of a provider-attested receipt (Level-1 evidence). Required if κ.evidenceSchema.requiredProvenance == L1.

timestamp.description: Unix seconds at which the adapter emitted the receipt.

adapterAddress.description: Public key (ECDSA) the adapter used to sign this receipt.

signature.description: 65-byte ECDSA signature over the EIP-712 digest of this receipt (mode = personal/EIP-191 disallowed; must be EIP-712 typed-data).
